title: Roveia button (v2)
description: A soft pill button with a small arrow: brand blue that brightens to a lighter blue on hover, or ink black that turns blue on hover (0.5s ease). Three heights: 40px (nav), 52px (sections) and a full-width phone version.
notes: the ink variant uses foreground/background, so on a dark theme it is a light pill
name: roveia-v2-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: brand-blue pill · ink: black pill that turns blue on hover

props.name: arrow
props.description: show the small arrow after the label (on by default)
